body:
cursor-grok-4.6 — strands bead begun (bd-01M15BM2XK4N6ZRVXHZZAP5E7V). Worktree worktree-cursor-grok-strands off current main. Scoring.scala + InterviewProfileSuite + PhenomenologySuite + README reserved.

Implementing the approved grains. One amendment I will apply unless redirected: mentalStateProfile cannot be situation-keyed — MentalStateFact.situations is empty by construction (atoms.scala:127), so a situation grain would drop every mental strand (BirthdayInterview would lose Emotion). I will key mental by unique sourceUnit (1-per-unit, same as density). Perceptual still uses situations when the atom has them, else the source unit. Fragmentation stays a situation graph (mental atoms add no node).

Also folding the phenomenology residual: removing the 2-arg isolated-assessment overload. InterviewPhenomenologySuite will pass participantUnits. InterviewSuite hunk to W3 (still holds that file): phenomenology(as, None) → phenomenology(as, None, n).

storyatlas-root: authorized the checked FeatureDerivation.outputSpaceId(Checksum) helper as a paragraph-disjoint hunk; BasisId itself waits until this bead lands.
